app_fee.value: USD 155 for international applicants (USD 135 for U.S. citizens and permanent residents).
app_fee.quote: The application fee is $135 for U.S. citizens and U.S. permanent residents, and $155 for all international applicants.

fee_waiver.value: Fee waivers are only for U.S. citizens, permanent residents and DACA/AB540 applicants; international students are not eligible.
fee_waiver.quote: Fee Waivers are available to qualified domestic applicants only. | international students are not eligible

gre_general.value: Set by each program; some programs require the GRE and there is no minimum score. See the program record.
gre_general.quote: The GRE test scores are required for some programs. | Please check with your program to verify if the GRE test is required.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT overall 80 (or 4 on the new scale, from January 2026). Some departments add a Speaking minimum for teaching assistants.
toefl_min.quote: An overall minimum score of 80 (traditional scale) or 4 (new scale, starting January 2026)

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic overall 7 with no module below 6.
ielts_min.quote: An overall minimum score of 7 for admission, with no less than 6 on any individual module.

english_waiver.value: The English test is waived only if your undergraduate or master's institution is listed in the World Higher Education Database (WHED) with English as the sole language of instruction; otherwise a test is required.
english_waiver.quote: Applicants are waived from the English Language Proficiency requirement if they have earned an undergraduate or master’s degree from an institution at which English was the sole language of instruction according to the World Higher Education Database (WHED). | If English is not the sole language of instruction listed or if no language is listed at all, the waiver does not apply and the applicant is required to take and pass an approved English proficiency test.

notes: TA-eligibility oral English rules apply separately to funded students; many departments state their own Speaking minimums.
